resources.string: Each input is limited to 16,000 UTF-16 code units. Shorten the input; nothing has been truncated.
Each input is limited to 200 lines, including a trailing empty line after a final newline. Shorten the input; nothing has been truncated.

Compares whole lines, not words or meanings. Case always matters. Exact mode compares spaces and tabs too. Ignore ASCII whitespace mode trims leading/trailing ASCII spaces and tabs and collapses their runs within each line; it does not ignore newlines or other Unicode whitespace. CRLF and lone CR line endings are normalized to LF for comparison; original editor text is preserved. A final newline creates a visible empty line, so adding or removing it is a difference. An empty document is represented by one empty line.

+ Added, − Removed, = Unchanged; ≈ Equivalent after whitespace normalization (both original versions shown). Empty lines are displayed as [empty line]. These markers are presentation labels, not a patch file. The complete bounded result can be scrolled, copied or shared.

Text may contain private information. Automatic history and remembered results are off by default for this tool. If you enable them or save manually, text can be stored locally. Sharing sends the reviewed text to the app you choose.
Explicit imports restore inputs only; press Compare. Remember results, if enabled, can reconstruct the last completed comparison.
This comparison exceeds local history or saved-result limits. It will not be retained there; you can still copy or share the complete result. Nothing is truncated.
Enter two texts and press Compare.
The saved comparison inputs are invalid. Your current texts were kept.
Mode: Ignore ASCII spaces and tabs within each line
